name: Hobb Gallowsby, Toll-Captain
place: wilds: holds Fitockpi Ford with a brigand camp (zone 'test', ~1600, 832); respawn 20 min per copy
_doc: Stream E. The wilds ELITE. A talker. He demands a toll from the farthest player (a circle that follows them — run it away from the group), scatters caltrops that stay, and whistles for archers on the bank (three circles on random players). At 60% he calls two brigands; at 35% he stops talking and spins his cleaver (a get-in-close ring). He binds his own wounds with an interruptible bandage.
party: Open world elite. Solo: tough at level — kite the toll circle, interrupt the bandage. 2-3: intended. 5+: quick. M5 scaling: health by players tagged; adds 2 -> 3 at five; archer circles +1 per extra player.

pull: Ho there! This ford's got a toll on it. Everything you're carrying ought to cover it.
Toll's gone up. On account of your faces.
Nobody crosses Fitockpi without paying Hobb.
say.death: Hobb Gallowsby sits down hard in the shallows. 'Keep... the change,' he wheezes.
say.reset: Hobb wanders back to his toll stool, counting coins that aren't there.

toll_due.name: Toll Due
say: Pay up, {target}, or pay in blood!

caltrops.name: Caltrops
caltrops.say: Hobb flings a fistful of caltrops.

bandage.name: Bind Wounds
bandage.say: Hobb ducks back to bind his wounds — stop him!

onInterrupt.say: Hobb drops his bandage in the mud. 'Oh, come ON.'

whirl.name: Whirling Cleaver
whirl.say: Hobb starts spinning — get in close!
